Choose the right place to ask for help

  • Installation or first use: start with our download and setup guides and beginner tutorial.
  • Reproducible app bug: search the official issue tracker linked above before creating a new report.
  • Community bridge problem: check the bridge project linked in our ComfyUI setup guide; a community integration has its own maintainer.
  • General discussion: use the community chat link above. Check current community rules before posting.

What to include in a bug report

Include the PhotoCraft version, operating system, package type, exact reproduction steps, expected result and actual result. Start from a small non-sensitive sample and mention whether the problem also occurs in a new document.

For a PSD issue, describe the affected layer, font and color mode. For an integration issue, name the bridge or plugin and its version. Use our reporting checklist to organize the details; remove private file paths and credentials from logs before sharing.

Sources & scope

Written from official documentation and editorial guidance. Not an exhaustive compatibility test. Menu names and behavior can change between releases.
